authorizationAndLimits: This is an executable repair analysis, not an active source, QA, offer or runtime mutation. Only this output and /dev/shm temporary scripts were written. No Git command was run.

normativeResult.ownCanonicalOffer: The existing rollout policy explicitly permits study-oriented preparation without a state filter. It is legitimate to author a finite, reviewed own canonical basic Informatics offering on that basis. Neither a universal national official mandatory syllabus nor a new owner approval loop is required or inferred. Each included performance still needs the task-specific official-or-necessary-gap justification and level judgment.
normativeResult.countryVsCanonical: Canonical GK and HE/BY official GK are distinct contracts. A canonical goal can be supported at basic level in one state and at elevated level in another. The target identity remains stable; state-and-course selection belongs to specific reviewed composition views and mappings, not to indiscriminate deletion of a global GK tag.
normativeResult.mathChemistryLimit: The Math curated-union and Chemistry selected-topic decisions are subject-specific evidence, not automatically Informatics policy. General canonical purpose and the present repair authorization suffice for a routine justified finite Informatics repair.
normativeResult.sourceLevelLimit: CQR004 tests that source expected course levels are a subset of canonical tags. It does not test that every canonical GK assignment has a source GK authorization. A source LK -> canonical GK+LK edge can pass. Official passages and pairwise jurisdiction/course assertions must be reviewed separately.

existingModel.backendBoundary: CompositionViewService.LEARNER_SCOPE_DIMENSIONS uses exactly those five keys; isConstrainedLearnerScope rejects unknown keys. findLearnerScopeView additionally requires exact schoolForm and stage. existingModel.selectionOrder: Repository views are sorted by descending authored scope-size, then stage/course fallback preferences and viewId. Two different content contracts with identical scope dimensions are not selectable alternatives; lexical choice/merge behavior is not a course decision.
existingModel.roles: goalEntry/canonicalSubtree projectionRole defaults to target. prerequisiteOnly is available for genuinely needed prior competence and excludes frontier/progress/target completion. It is not an optional-topic selector, a mastery write, or evidence of competence.
existingModel.courseMetadata: Global tags GK/LK and applicability.jurisdiction are separable sets, not an arbitrary jurisdiction x course product. Use precise HE-GK, HE-LK and canonical GK views to avoid falsely projecting a GK claim in all jurisdictions.

existingModel.noUnitRuntime: LearningUnit ownership, recognition and unit gates remain conceptual here. This repair must use existing goals, views, assessment payloads and QA without enabling PR83 or adding a new progress model.

The complete late12 path supplied here contains OOP, recursion, lists, graphs, information security and project work, not a Q2 database obligation. Every required missing foundation must have a real preparation plan; prerequisiteOnly merely classifies support. Check full atomic transitive minimality and every affected consumer.
